category_title: At-risk eighth-graders with low self-efficacy and negative dispositions toward writing in mathematics
scenario_title: Writing explanations for multi-step word problems in math journals
minimal_context: The student is working independently in math class to solve a multi-step word problem about a parking lot and write the explanation in paragraph form in their math journal.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the grocery store parking lot problem on the board. I want you to solve it and answer it in paragraph form in your math journals.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Math is numbers not letters. Math and writing don’t go 2-gether.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to write down the steps you take to find the answer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I hate to write expesially in math.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to tell how you solve the problem in writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can’t evn get why she would me make me rite in her class. Nobody has made me tell how I solve problems and never in writing did I have to do this!
